title: About page
content:
About Larkspur Supply Co..

Our story: Twelve paddlers and climbers founded the co-op in 1987 in a rented garage. Today 9,400 members own it, and every member gets one vote at the annual meeting.

What we believe (three principles):
1. Repair before replace. Our workshop fixed 3,100 items last year.
2. Pay people fairly. Every employee earns at least the regional living wage.
3. Leave places better. We give 2% of sales to trail and shoreline groups.

Milestones:
- 1987: Founded in a garage on Pier Road.
- 1999: Opened the Alder Street store.
- 2014: Started the rental program.
- 2023: Opened the repair workshop.

A quote from the board chair, Ines Okafor: "We are not here to sell more gear. We are here to help people get outside with the gear they already have."

Links: Read the annual report (/reports/2025.pdf), Meet the team (/team).
